subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: If If new-feature contract work is proposed as a PRD ledger entry, technical design, brainstorm record, or review report during cutover in a repository whose legacy document gate remains enabled, including a proposal opened before cutover, then the system shall refuse it, naming the feature draft as the path; preserve the Pyxis-source bypass and permitted existing-feature evolution
intent: in an enabled repository, the refusal with the draft remedy; in Pyxis source, no restored legacy-gate finding
fit_criterion: Enabled-cutover new-feature fixtures refuse each corpus-document kind with the remedy and accept plans; permitted existing-feature amendments and successors remain accepted. A Pyxis-source fixture does not produce an automated legacy finding for those files, and source authoring instructions still direct new features to drafts.
